name: barrensteppe siege
mana cost: {2}{W}{B}
types: enchantment
replacement: as this enchantment enters, choose abzan or mardu.
static: • abzan — at the beginning of your end step, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
static: • mardu — at the beginning of your end step, if a creature died under your control this turn, each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice.
